[[Ensign Lumi]] is a [[Corsair]] [[boss]] that has been encountered in multiple areas, most notably in the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]], just west of the entrance to [[Beknur Harbor]].

== Locations ==
* [[Istan]]
** {{NPC location|Cliffs of Dohjok}} (just west of the entrance to Beknur Harbor)
** {{NPC location|Issnur Isles}} (South of the corsair keep)
** {{NPC location|Lahtenda Bog}} (near collector [[Ahchin]])
** {{NPC location|Mehtani Keys}} (near [[Commander Werishakul]])
** {{NPC location|Zehlon Reach}} (near [[Sinni]])
